purpose: Battered civilian shuttle candidates for the GalaxyQuest start screen

preparation.source: Image generator; independent single-object three-quarter views, not views of one shared ship
preparation.alpha: Use existing source alpha; values <=8 set to 0, values >=250 set to 255, others unchanged before resizing
preparation.resize: Resize whole image to fit 896x896 with Pillow LANCZOS; center on transparent 1024x1024 RGBA canvas without mask multiplication
preparation.background_removal: Not needed; source PNGs already contain transparency
preparation.review: Prepared silhouettes visually inspected; all landing feet and engine housings remain in frame

assets.brief: Boxy mustard-yellow industrial cargo shuttle with battered engine cowling
Bulky rounded cream-and-teal passenger shuttle with patched hull and damaged engine shroud
Low blocky faded-red utility shuttle with welded patches and torn attached armor panel

limitations: These are image-to-3D input candidates, not generated or accepted 3D assets.
Hidden rear and underside geometry will be inferred; image detail does not guarantee mesh or PBR quality.
The facility-only generator does not consume this shuttle manifest; use the separate shuttle generator.
Generated shuttle meshes require inspection and are not integrated into the start screen.
